summary: Frontend testing of Diabetes Buddy Expo/RN web preview at mobile viewport (375x667). All 13 screens load and major flows function. AsyncStorage persistence verified across navigations. One UX bug confirmed: header back arrow (chevron-left) is missing on every inner screen because the (drawer)/_layout.tsx sets headerLeft: undefined on each Stack.Screen, which suppresses the default Stack back button.

ui_bugs.issue: Header back arrow does NOT appear on /patient, /medications, /summary, /insulin-titration, /hypo-risk, /foods, /plate, /diet-plan, /renal-dosing, /ckd-guideline, /prediabetes, /progress. Each Stack.Screen in app/(drawer)/_layout.tsx sets `headerLeft: undefined`, which in Expo Router removes the default back button entirely (it does NOT fall back to the chevron). Users on web/iOS lose in-app back affordance and have to rely on browser/system back. Test request explicitly requires 'Header back navigation (left arrow) works on inner screens'.

action_items: Fix header back navigation in /app/frontend/app/(drawer)/_layout.tsx: remove `headerLeft: undefined` on inner Stack.Screen entries OR explicitly render a back button (router.back()) for them. Keep MenuButton only on the `index` (Dashboard) and `menu` screens. Suggested pattern: define a BackButton component (TouchableOpacity with chevron-back icon, testID='back-btn', onPress=router.back()) and set `headerLeft: () => <BackButton />` for each inner screen, OR rely on the default by simply omitting the headerLeft override (then Expo Router will render the platform default chevron when there is something to pop on the stack).
critical_code_review_comments: (drawer)/_layout.tsx repeats `headerLeft: undefined` for every inner screen — this both removes the default back arrow and is a maintenance smell. Refactor by inverting: set headerLeft only on `index` and `menu` (MenuButton) and leave inner screens with the default.

Insulin Titration and Progress screens correctly gate UI behind patient data ('Enter patient data first.'), good UX. However the gate text is plain 'Load patient data first.' on Progress vs 'Enter patient data first' on Insulin — minor inconsistency.
patient.tsx is 299 lines; consider extracting Demographics / Anthropometrics / Comorbidity sections into smaller components (file is approaching the soft 700-line limit but already busy).
Console showed repeated WARN: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from a third-party RN web component. Non-blocking but worth tracking.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (16/17 high-level checks pass; only header back navigation fails)

seed_data_creation: Used built-in Load Example button which seeds Patient K (Kochi): age 55, BMI 28.6, eGFR 45 (CKD Stage 3a Moderate), HbA1c 8.2, FBS 160. AsyncStorage persisted this across screens within the session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified flows on mobile 375x667 viewport: (1) Dashboard at / shows welcome card + 8 quick-tool cards when no patient. (2) Header menu-btn opens /menu modal listing 13 tools, all navigate. (3) /patient → Load Example seeds Patient K with BMI 28.6 + eGFR 45 (CKD-EPI auto-calc). new-med + add-med-btn adds pill, new-bg + add-bg-btn adds reading. generate-summary-btn navigates to /summary. (4) /medications shows ADA pathway with Empagliflozin first-line. (5) /hypo-risk auto-applies eGFR 30-59 +2 factor (1 active factor → 2 points → Low Risk) when patient is loaded. (6) /prediabetes correctly shows 'Overt Diabetes' state for HbA1c 8.2 / FBS 160. (7) /plate exposes testIDs plate-veggie/plate-protein/plate-grain, all tap-able. (8) /diet-plan, /renal-dosing, /ckd-guideline, /foods, /summary all render content. ONE BUG: header back arrow missing on all inner screens (see ui_bugs). After fix, retest by navigating Dashboard → menu-btn → /patient and verify chevron-back appears on /patient header (testID can be 'back-btn').
rca_of_issue: Bug: missing header back arrow on inner screens. RCA: In expo-router/React Navigation, providing `headerLeft: undefined` in screenOptions overrides (and removes) the default headerLeft renderer instead of restoring it. The (drawer)/_layout.tsx sets a default `headerLeft: () => <MenuButton />` at the Stack level, then explicitly nullifies it on every inner Stack.Screen via `headerLeft: undefined`. The result is no headerLeft renderer at all on inner screens, hence no back chevron. Reproduction: open https://wellness-app-138.preview.emergentagent.com/patient (or any inner screen) — header shows only the title with no left icon. Mitigation: either (a) define a tiny BackButton component using router.back() and set headerLeft on each inner screen, or (b) restructure the layout so MenuButton is set only on index and menu screens and inner screens inherit the platform default by NOT overriding headerLeft.
